data.body:
Fixes bug Bffe85a63a5: Found by GP-research: ddflow task add refused GP-migrate as a possible duplicate (needs --new) inside a shell loop of 15 adds; the refusal exits non-zero but prints only candidate hints, and nothing says the item was NOT created; a script that tails the output reads it as success. Say 'not added' explicitly in the refusal. Found on GP-research.

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-Bffe85a63a5 --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed Bffe85a63a5 --regression-test <test>` first).
data.title: Fix bug Bffe85a63a5: task add duplicate refusal is easy to lose in a batch of adds

data.note: lane7: make the duplicate-refusal message say 'not added' explicitly

evidence.note: Claim CONFIRMED: ddflow/api/_dedupe_reason.py::reason() builds the refusal as 'refused: possible duplicate. It reads like:' + candidate lines with no 'not added', so `task add` refused as a possible duplicate in a batch prints only hints and a script tailing stderr reads it as success. Falsifier: install the fix task's test, watch test_a_refusal_says_the_item_was_not_added fail on the unfixed message ('not added' not in out.reason). Probe: pre-edit source had no 'not added' substring in reason().

AGENTS.md four enforced rules: a bug is not closed without a regression test failing pre-fix (added test_a_refusal_says_the_item_was_not_added asserting 'not added' in the refusal); outcome recorded honestly; author deepseek, reviewer will be a different model family (qwen3.8-flash-next-fp8). work_in_small_slices: one message string + one test. commit_requires_file_lease: globs set on the fix task to ddflow/api/_dedupe_reason.py and tests/test_dedupe_named_ids.py before committing.

Changed ddflow/api/_dedupe_reason.py line 13 'refused: possible duplicate. It reads like:' -> 'refused: possible duplicate (not added). It reads like:'; keeps the 'refused: possible duplicate' prefix the CLI/shot tests already assert. Added regression test test_a_refusal_says_the_item_was_not_added in tests/test_dedupe_named_ids.py asserting 'not added' in out.reason. Commit 4ebaf3f59 on branch ddflow/fix-Bffe85a63a5.

roborev review 4ebaf3f590541a70a598bf347021c47d2fe54ec7 (job 3927): no issues found. It CONFIRMED the new test genuinely fails against the unfixed code (the phrase 'not added' occurs nowhere else in the old reason text) and that sibling tests indexing fixed line positions are unaffected.
